slides.title: Future Plans & Arrangements (A2)
slides.body:
Kelajak haqida gapirish

A2 darajasida biz kelajakdagi rejalarni ifodalash uchun asosan 'Going to' va 'Present Continuous' zamonlaridan foydalanamiz.

slides.title: Niyat va Rejalar (Going to)
slides.body:
Biz oldindan o'ylab qo'yilgan niyatlar uchun 'be + going to + verb' ishlatamiz.

I am going to visit my friend.

Agar vaqt va joyi aniq belgilangan bo'lsa, Present Continuous ishlatamiz.

We are meeting at 5 PM tomorrow.
slides.title: Aniq kelishuvlar (Arrangements)
Going to vs Present Continuous
slides.body:
• Going to: Niyat (I want to do it).
  • Present Continuous: Aniq kelishuv (I have a ticket/appointment).

slides.title: Inkor gaplar (Negative)
slides.body:
Inkor shaklida 'not' qo'shimchasini qo'shamiz.

I am not going to travel this summer.

Yordamchi fe'l (am/is/are) gap boshiga chiqadi.

Are you going to study tonight?
slides.title: Savol gaplar (Questions)

slides.body: Kelajakni bildiruvchi so'zlar: tomorrow, next week, tonight, this weekend.

classroomData.name: CEFR C1

errors: She was working for 2 hours when I called -> She had been working for 2 hours when I called (O'tgan zamondagi ikki harakat ketma-ketligida davomiy harakat uchun Past Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi)
I have been waiting for an hour when he arrived -> I had been waiting for an hour when he arrived (O'tgan zamon kontekstida 'have' emas, 'had' ishlatiladi)
They had waiting for the bus all morning -> They had been waiting for the bus all morning (Past Perfect Continuous formulasida 'been' so'zi tushib qolmasligi kerak)
He had been sleep for 10 hours -> He had been sleeping for 10 hours (Fe'lga -ing qo'shimchasi qo'shilishi shart)
We had been play football before it started to rain -> We had been playing football before it started to rain (Fe'lning davomiy shakli -ing bilan yasaladi)
She had been study English for years -> She had been studying English for years (Study fe'li -ing shaklida yozilishi kerak)
I had been cook dinner when the lights went out -> I had been cooking dinner when the lights went out (Cook fe'li -ing shaklida bo'lishi kerak)
They had been run for a long time -> They had been running for a long time (Run fe'li -ing shaklida ikkita 'n' bilan yoziladi)
Had you been eat before the party? -> Had you been eating before the party? (Eat fe'li -ing shaklida bo'lishi kerak)
She had been not working hard -> She had not been working hard (Inkor shaklida 'not' so'zi 'had' va 'been' orasida keladi)

slides.body:
O'tgan zamonda davomiy harakat

Past Perfect Continuous (o'tgan mukammal davomiy zamon) o'tgan zamonda boshlanib, yana bir o'tgan zamon harakatigacha davom etgan jarayonni ifodalaydi.

Misol: I had been waiting for an hour when the bus finally arrived.
slides.title: Past Perfect Continuous nima?

slides.body:
Subject + had been + V-ing

  • Darak: She had been studying.
  • Inkor: She had not (hadn't) been studying.
  • So'roq: Had she been studying?
slides.title: Grammatik tuzilma

slides.body:
Biz bu zamonni o'tgan zamondagi biror voqea sodir bo'lgunga qadar davom etgan harakatni ta'kidlash uchun ishlatamiz.

Diqqat: Natijaga emas, jarayonning davomiyligiga urg'u beriladi.
slides.title: Qachon ishlatamiz?
Vaqt ko'rsatkichlari
slides.body:
Past Perfect Continuous ko'pincha quyidagi so'zlar bilan keladi:

  • For (bir necha soat davomida)
  • Since (soat nechalardan beri)
  • Before (biror narsadan oldin)
  • When (biror narsa sodir bo'lganda)

slides.title: Past Continuous vs Past Perfect Continuous
slides.body:
Past Continuous: O'tgan zamonda shunchaki davom etayotgan harakat (I was sleeping).

Past Perfect Continuous: O'tgan zamondagi boshqa harakatgacha bo'lgan davomiylik (I had been sleeping for 2 hours before he woke me up).

Tayyormisiz?

Endi mashqlarni bajarish orqali bilimlaringizni mustahkamlang!

classroomData.essayPrompt: O'tgan yili erishgan maqsadlaringiz yoki hayotingizdagi biror davr haqida yozing. 'Past Perfect Continuous' zamonidan foydalanib, biror muhim voqea sodir bo'lishidan oldin nimalar bilan band bo'lganingizni tasvirlang. Masalan, imtihonga tayyorgarlik ko'rganingiz, sport bilan shug'ullanganingiz yoki chet tilini o'rganganingiz haqida yozishingiz mumkin. Matningiz kamida 8-10 ta gapdan iborat bo'lsin. Har bir gapda o'sha davrda qancha vaqt davomida nima qilayotganingizni aniq ko'rsating. Bu sizning o'tgan zamondagi jarayonlarni qanchalik yaxshi tushunganingizni tekshirishga yordam beradi.

classroomData.essayPrompt: O'zingizning kundalik tartibingiz haqida 8-10 ta gap yozing. Har kuni nimalar qilishingizni tasvirlab bering. Masalan: soat nechida uyg'onasiz, nimalar yeyishni yoqtirasiz, maktabga qanday borasiz va bo'sh vaqtingizda nimalar bilan shug'ullanasiz. 'Present Simple' qoidalariga rioya qiling. Gaplaringizni 'I wake up...', 'I eat...', 'I go...' kabi boshlang. O'zingizning maqsadlaringiz haqida ham yozib o'ting. Matnni xatosiz yozishga harakat qiling.

slides.body:
Doimiy takrorlanadigan ish-harakatlar

Present Simple — bu bizning kundalik odatlarimiz, umumiy haqiqatlar va doimiy holatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan zamon.

Misol: I drink coffee every morning. (Men har kuni ertalab qahva ichaman.)
slides.title: Present Simple nima?
Tasdiq shakli (Affirmative)
slides.body:
Formula: Subject + Verb (+s/es)

  • I / You / We / They + work
  • He / She / It + works

Eslatma: Uchinchi shaxs birlikda (He, She, It) fe'lga -s yoki -es qo'shiladi.

Yordamchi fe'llar: do not / does not

Inkor yasash uchun do not (don't) yoki does not (doesn't) ishlatamiz.

I don't like apples.
She doesn't like apples.
slides.title: Inkor shakli (Negative)
So'roq shakli (Interrogative)
slides.body:
Do / Does gap boshiga chiqadi

Savol berish uchun gap boshiga Do yoki Does qo'yiladi.

Do you speak English?
Does he play football?

Present Simple'ni qanday aniqlaymiz?

  • Always (har doim)
  • Usually (odatda)
  • Often (tez-tez)
  • Sometimes (ba'zida)
  • Every day (har kuni)
slides.title: Vaqt ko'rsatkichlari

slides.body:
Endi navbat sizga!

O'z kundalik odatlaringiz haqida 5 ta gap tuzing. Masalan: 'I wake up at 7 o'clock'.
